newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil shrs end higher led by Eletrobras.
newsitem.headline: Brazil shrs end higher led by Eletrobras.

text.p: SAO PAULO, Oct 4 (reuter) - Brazil shares see-sawed to close higher 0.32 percent amid heavy foreign buying of state power firm Eletrobras shares, traders said.
The Bovespa index of the 49 most traded shares ended up 211 points at 66,269 points. Turnover was a light 311 million reais ($308.3 million).
Eletrobras preferred closed up 1.68 percent at 302 reais.

Analysts said foreigners were interested in Eletrobras shares because BNDES Participacoes, the investment wing of Brazil's National Development Bank, will auction off on Monday 149.5 million of Eletrobras common shares, or 0.28 percent of its total capital, in the foward market.

For next week, analysts expect the bourse to continue rising but futher developments on the country's municipal elections coupled with the release of trade balance figures may trigger some profit taking.

Among other winners traders cited Minas Gerais state power firm Cemig whose preferred share ended up 2.25 percent at 31.80 reais. Mining giant Vale do Rio Doce preferred share rose 1.69 percent to end at 21 reais.
Benchmark Telebras preferred share, the big loser, closed down 0.61 percent at 82 reais.
The Sao Paulo bourse's Power Sector Index rose 1.22 pct closing at 1,683 pts
